source_title: Pisces Horoscope Today, October 28, 2026: Business Will Get a New Direction, Mind Will Blossom with Auspicious News - India Today
source_excerpt:
Pisces Zodiac Sign Horoscope Prediction Today: Efforts for communication and dialogue will be favourable. You will maintain harmony with everyone. Matters of love and affection will gain strength. There will be attempts to seize opportunities.
You will maintain contact and communication with relatives. You will show enthusiasm in expressing important matters. Matters related to work expansion will improve. Business trips will increase. Emphasis will be on discussion and dialogue. You will give up laziness. Avoid unnecessary discussions. Your working situation will improve. Everyone will be impressed by your courage and valour. All colleagues will remain supportive. Stay free from worries. You will take an interest in social work. Efforts to maintain contact and communication will be favourable. You will maintain harmony with everyone. Matters of love and affection will gain strength. You will try to make the most of opportunities.
Job and Business - Commercial work will gain momentum. You will fulfil financial responsibilities. Work expansion will be as expected. A professional trip may take place. You will achieve your goals. You will engage in cooperative work.
Wealth and Property - Financial gains will be better. Auspicious news will be received. The shared aspect will be strong. The spirit of cooperation will continue. You will maintain focus on work and business. You will benefit from business relationships.
Love and Friendship - You will maintain ease and balance in love. Matters of the heart will be favourable. You will meet your beloved. You will participate in natural conversations. Maintain humility. Pleasant news will progress. You will receive support and trust from all. Happiness and improvement will continue in relationships. You will honour and respect guests. Emotional strength will increase.
Health and Morale - You will remain active. Focus will be on health improvement. Personality and morale will be strengthened. Work pace will be fast and you will maintain grandeur. Tasks will be completed on time.
Today’s remedy: First and foremost, worship and praise Lord Ganesha. Donate green items. Listen to religious stories. - Ends
Astrologer Pandit Arunesh Kumar Sharma has been associated with astrology for three decades. He has been deeply involved in Vedic Astrology, Numerology, Vastu Shastra, Numerology and Oceanography. Proficient in studying palm, handwriting and signature, he is also a Yogini meditator and Yogini card reader. He has been involved in national and international seminars of astrology and has done rich research on astrology remedies with the help of seven 'swara'. He has written for various national newspapers and magazines of the country. Apart from the national level digital platform, he has done 'Sitaron Ki Chaal' program for TV.
